name: Ichige Moka
source:
A girl whom Kuuki played with when he was a child.
Despite the news that she had passed away from illness, Moka appears before Kuraugi as an AR avatar.
Kuraugi has almost no memory of the past, so she suggests that they create a flower garden together to remember his memories.
